rendered: The Mn-doped LNO sample with the higher manganese content, 50% Mn[1], generated less heat in the thermal decomposition tests. Its heat was 485.7[2] J/g, against 901.4[3] J/g for the lower-manganese sample, 10% Mn[4]. The legend of the heat-flow panel gives the same values: Fig. 4[5]. Note that the text just before these numbers says the opposite, that tems with lower Mn content generated comparatively less heat[6]. That sentence conflicts with the reported values, which show the lower-Mn sample giving off more heat.
